 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points[1], points[2]
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
    # Trace a diagonal from 1, then continue on the longer axis, stopping
    # one step before reaching 2 so the final colored cell is adjacent to 2.
    rr, cc = r1, c1
    while abs(r2 - rr) > 1 and abs(c2 - cc) > 1:
        rr += dr
        cc += dc
        out[rr][cc] = 3
    while abs(r2 - rr) > 1:
        rr += dr
        out[rr][cc] = 3
    while abs(c2 - cc) > 1:
        cc += dc
        out[rr][cc] = 3
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]
    demo[3][11] = 2
    demo[10][1] = 1
    result = transform(demo)
    expected = [[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]
    expected[3][11] = 2
    expected[10][1] = 1
    for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]:
        expected[r][c] = 3
    assert result == expected
    test = [[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]
    test[1][4] = 1
    test[13][12] = 2
    print(transform(test))
    print('demo reproduced')
    assert result == expected
    assert transform(test)[12][11] == 3
    print('test endpoint verified')
",

}
